notes.title: PoligonVR 2024.5.12
notes.content:
[b]UI[/b]
Added a user volume slider to the user details menu.
Rearranged the user in-world specific actions which allows for more space when we add buttons such as vote kick.
Gave colored buttons a nicer design.
Improved UI for world pre-download.
Fixed user details reliability issues.


[b]Avatars[/b]
The height of avatars are now synced over the networked. This fixes scaling issues such as hiding an avatar that is really small which would result in the blocked avatar being "out of sync" in terms of scale.


[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
Fixed a softlock when a user attempts to join a world while suspended or with an expired session.


[b]Security[/b]
Accounts that have Two-Factor Authentication enabled will now require the code when changing display name, email or password.

notes.title: PoligonVR 2024.4.25 Build 162
notes.content:
We are still experimenting with publishing updates here instead of our Discord.


[b]CCK[/b]
Changed so mirrors can support cut-out mirrors (included as a CCK example for worlds).
Added so Shadow Distance and some other shadow settings are serialized and uploaded with your world.


[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
Fixed remote players rotation sometimes being laggy when joining a world.
Fixed a component scan bug which could cause "DynamicBone Roots" to throw an exception, preventing the rest of the components from being scanned.
Fixed a bug when a user would cancel a file upload, causing further uploads to stop working.
Possibly fixed an issue causing avatars to get stuck in the loading state.


[b]UI[/b]
Improved the keyboard UI by increasing the scale to make it a bit easier to use in VR.
Improved the scaling of the nameplates.
Added a sound when toggling your microphone.


[b]2FA[/b]
Fixed a client bug which caused 2FA codes that starts with a "0" to not work.


[b]Support Page[/b]
You can now create support tickets at https://help.poligonvr.com/
